crossRefs.note: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and…
Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him…
Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought…
Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
For Yahweh’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down…
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me…

translations.web: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
translations.bsb: The River Kishon swept them away, the ancient river, the River Kishon. March on, O my soul, in strength!
translations.kjv: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
translations.asv: The river Kishon swept them away, That ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, march on with strength.
